title: RISK-KV: Quality-Aware Selective KV Cache Reconstruction for Distributed LLM Inference
summary: RISK-KV replaces full KV cache retention/transfer and full token replay during request migration and interruption recovery, reconstructing missing layers' KV states via cross-layer ridge regression folded into the model's projection matrices. It costs a topology search with quality gating, per-layer-group predictor fitting, storage for regression parameters, and a measured NLL degradation that must stay under the gating threshold. It can fail if reconstruction error exceeds the quality gate on out-of-distribution inputs, if the 512-token-history speedup does not generalize to longer contexts, or if the reader's workload lacks migration/recovery events frequent enough to amortize the search and fitting overhead.
rationale: The gain is validated only for a narrow recovery scenario on three models, so it merits workload-specific testing rather than direct adoption in a single-GPU or API-based setup.
